target: acceptance 3 — the output names these as PROXIES for comprehension debt, not a measurement of it. Asserted on the rendered TSV a human reads, not on prose in a doc.
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic/observability; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; cp "$FIXTURES/comprehension/events.jsonl" .agentic/observability/events-20260801.jsonl; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; o=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" comprehension --format tsv 2>/dev/null); p=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -ci "proxy\|proxies"); printf '{"labelled":%s}' "$p"
